question: Among surface coating materials for high-energy lithium-ion cathodes, which has the highest Li-ion diffusivity listed?
rendered: According to Table 5, Li0.6TiO2 has the highest Li-ion diffusivity listed at 1.3 × 10^− 11 cm^2/s at 300 K.
